note: Held-out test-set evaluation (physics_jepa_test.csv.gz, 951 structures) for both fine-tuning strategies. Inherits all caveats of the underlying bounded local foundation_jepa pretraining and physics_jepa fine-tuning runs (see physics_jepa_evaluation_report.md). UPDATED from the original report: Tc is now reported under BOTH the bare (uncorrected) Allen-Dynes interpolation formula AND the f1-strong-coupling-corrected formula (allen_dynes_tc(..., apply_strong_coupling_correction=True), the new default in physics_utils.py). The f2 correction (needs the spectral second moment omega2) is NOT applied to model predictions -- the heads only predict (lambda_ep, omega_log), with no omega2 prediction pathway -- see the f2_auxiliary_* fields below for an illustrative ground-truth-only estimate of f2's magnitude on the 48 test rows that carry a raw alpha^2F spectrum.

f2_auxiliary_ground_truth_only.note: NOT a model-prediction evaluation -- computed entirely from ground-truth lambda_ep/omega_log/omega2 on the subset of test rows with a reliable raw alpha^2F spectrum, to illustrate f2's potential magnitude. omega2 was reconstructed from a2f_original_{x,y} via omega2 = sqrt(2*integral(a2F*w dw) / lambda_check), lambda_check = 2*integral(a2F/w dw), keeping rows where lambda_check matches the stored lambda_ep within 30% (33 of 48 has_a2f_spectrum=True rows passed this filter).
